g.title: pp3_vpp2_example
g.text: One example: PP3 + VPP2 + M-FSDP v2 + combined 1F1B

g.title: config
g.text: The schedule shown for one pipeline lane is repeated by its dense-DP and expert-DP peers.

g.title: topology
g.text: Logical virtual-pipeline path for every microbatch
Forward physically visits P0 → P1 → P2 → P0 → P1 → P2. Backward traverses the reverse path.

g.title: lookup
g.text: VPP lookup: M=6, two chunks, microbatch group size defaults to PP=3

g.title: schedules
g.text: Exact local scheduler order with one extra EP-overlap warmup forward
F m0/C0 · F m1/C0 · F m2/C0 · F m0/C1
F m1/C1 · F m2/C1 · F m3/C0 · F m4/C0
F m4/C1 + B m2/C1 · F m5/C1 + B m0/C0
B m1/C0 · B m2/C0 · B m3/C1 · B m4/C1
B m5/C1 · B m3/C0 · B m4/C0 · B m5/C0
F m0/C0 · F m1/C0 · F m2/C0
F m0/C1 · F m1/C1 · F m2/C1
F m3/C0+B m0/C1 · F m4/C0+B m1/C1 · F m5/C0+B m2/C1
F m3/C1+B m0/C0 · F m4/C1+B m1/C0 · F m5/C1+B m2/C0
B m3/C1 · B m4/C1 · B m5/C1
B m3/C0 · B m4/C0 · B m5/C0
F m1/C1+B m0/C1 · F m2/C1+B m1/C1
F m3/C0+B m2/C1 · F m4/C0+B m0/C0 · F m5/C0+B m1/C0
F m3/C1+B m2/C0 · F m4/C1+B m3/C1 · F m5/C1+B m4/C1
Each row is exact local call order, not a shared wall-clock timeline. P2P dependencies determine when ranks can actually advance.

g.title: focus
g.text: Focus on P0's same-chunk steady step: forward m3/C1 + backward m1/C1
This is a normal forward for a new microbatch while an older microbatch runs backward through the same model chunk.

g.title: fsdp
g.text: M-FSDP v2 work nested inside the focused combined step

g.title: problems
g.text: What this one example says the design must solve
